title: Pathognomonic

inlines.v: PATHOGNOMON'IC, adjective [Gr. passion or suffering, and to know.] Indicating that which is inseparable from a disease, being found in that and in no other; hence, indicating that by which a disease may be certainly known; characteristic; as pathognomonic symptoms.
